quality.fingerprint_algorithm: SHA256 of sorted compact canonical JSON
quality.authorship_scope: Known historical error categories informed coverage. New authored language/worlds; same author/policy, not independent human or external benchmark.

scope: Evaluation-only, failure-category-informed authored synthetic cohort. V8 train/validation content not read; test labels/answers excluded from candidate prompts and SFT.
arm_id_status: Exact three IDs confirmed by parent evaluator; draft until complete source/data/config seal.
budget_includes: All model calls, rejected actions, repairs and customer turns; no hidden warmups or retries to obtain a pass.

training_candidate.base: Same pinned decoded-4bit-derived FP16 frozen base
training_candidate.optimizer: Adam with previous betas/eps unchanged; exact config hash required before seal
training_candidate.checkpoint_rule: Only fixed final1344; no checkpoint selection.
training_candidate.validation_role: Monitoring/adoption judgment only; never choose checkpoint or retrain using this test.

planned_sampling.scope: Deterministic CPU schedule projection, not actual training coverage

metrics: Preserved business outcome/cohort success and paired failures
First raw seven fields/parse/all-enum/reason-enum before repair
Explicit-YES recall and unsupported-YES with separate denominators
Quote rejections/corrections and exact-slot vs backend normalization separately
Repeated question attempts/deliveries vs all identical actions
Necessary and unnecessary handoff; required answers and email
Raw scoped-consent attempts, proposals, commits and final orders separately
All calls, input/output token IDs, serial latency and all residual failures
quote_measurement_scope: Natural requests and actual clarification replies expose quote fidelity. No forced initial model mistake or injected failure in primary test. Corrections count only when an actual raw quote failure occurs; deterministic CPU probes are separate.

cpu_oracle_feasibility.scope: Authored deterministic feasibility, not model performance or training data.

before_any_gpu_model_use: New explicit V8 resource authorization bound to this sealed plan
before_test_inference: Actual completed1344 training and exact saved initialization independently verified
Fixed final adapter identity sealed before first test call
Keep complete development validation without test-based selection/retraining

test_revision_rule: Never adjust test cases, labels, denominators or inclusion after any V8 candidate output. Any necessary later revision requires a separate declared cohort/version, not replacement of this test.
adoption_scope: Business and scoped-consent audits remain distinct; no synthetic result certifies production reliability or closes unobserved semantic bypasses.

cross_development_fingerprint_audit.scope: Original independent test-author metadata-only check, plus final post-delivery integration audit. No author cases or labels changed.

customer_reply_protocol.undeclared_field_policy: Preserve observable task/protocol failure; never fabricate a reply or hide a retry.

cpu_contract_tests.scope: CPU data/protocol feasibility only; no candidate inference

parent_case_review.scope: Authored synthetic English, not external independent annotations

public_projection.scope: Private non-retail account/authorization and machine-path metadata omitted. Original verification claims refer to historical unredacted local artifacts, not these public bytes.
